description.value: Catoro is a rescue cat café, boba shop, and cat supply store in East Vancouver, where 15+ adoptable rescue cats roam a forest-themed indoor lounge. With over 1,400 cats adopted since opening in 2019, it is one of Vancouver's most distinctive community-oriented cafés. Visitors book in advance to spend time with the cats while enjoying bubble tea, and the space regularly hosts events like movie nights and yoga classes.
